paragraphs: R' Eliezer ben Shemaiah: Tosefta Parah, chapter 9.
R' Yirmeyah bar Shemaiah: Tanchuma, Vayigash, 6.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פ״ט gives Parah chapter 9, unlike machine פ״ם; ויגש־ו gives Vayigash 6 without a specified Tanchuma edition. Neither is newly verified.
לג: gives Shabbat 33b by convention. Three different sons grouped under Shemaiah do not establish one father. Yosef’s full title remains Rav; Eliezer/Yirmeyah remain R'.
